name: Relationship Type

fields.label: English label
fields.description: The label shown in English lists, filters and exports.

fields.label: Arabic label
fields.description: The Arabic label printed in Arabic exports and reports.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Stable machine code used by data imports, report filters and the migration. Values are never reused.

fields.label: Colour
fields.description: Badge colour used on cards, list indicators and reports.

fields.label: Sort order
fields.description: Position within its own list; lower comes first.

fields.label: Disabled
fields.description: Disabled values stay on existing records but are not offered for new ones.

fields.label: System value
fields.description: Seeded by the application; cannot be renamed or deleted.

fields.label: Inverse type
fields.description: The type that reads in the opposite direction ('student of' ⇄ 'teacher of'). Used for display and for duplicate detection; the stored edge is never duplicated.

fields.label: Symmetric
fields.description: True for colleague of, co-author with, partner of, relative of … A symmetric edge is stored once and read from both ends.

fields.label: Valid subject type
fields.description: Optional constraint on the subject end (e.g. Person), enforced in the Relationship controller.

fields.label: Is hierarchical
fields.description: Marks containment types ('located in', 'contains', 'member of') so the graph view can draw them as a hierarchy.

description: The `relationship_type` domain (33 seeded values) with its semantics: each type may name its `inverse_type` and declare itself symmetric. Inverse and symmetric behaviour is therefore *data*, not code — adding 'taught at' needs no deployment.
